  • Method Details

    • baseUrl

      WebClient.Builder baseUrl(String baseUrl)
      Configure a base URL for requests. Effectively a shortcut for: 

      String baseUrl = "https://abc.go.com/v1";
DefaultUriBuilderFactory factory = new DefaultUriBuilderFactory(baseUrl);
WebClient client = WebClient.builder().uriBuilderFactory(factory).build();

      `DefaultUriBuilderFactory` 用于为每个请求准备带有给定基本 URL 的 URL，除非针对给定 URL 的 URL 请求是绝对的，在这种情况下将忽略基本 URL。

      注意：此方法与uriBuilderFactory(UriBuilderFactory)互斥。如果同时使用两者，此处提供的 baseUrl 值将被忽略。

      See Also:
      • DefaultUriBuilderFactory(String)
      • uriBuilderFactory(UriBuilderFactory)

    • defaultUriVariables

      WebClient.Builder defaultUriVariables(Map<String,?> defaultUriVariables)
      Configure default URL variable values to use when expanding URI templates with a Map. Effectively a shortcut for: 

      Map<String, ?> defaultVars = ...;
DefaultUriBuilderFactory factory = new DefaultUriBuilderFactory();
factory.setDefaultVariables(defaultVars);
WebClient client = WebClient.builder().uriBuilderFactory(factory).build();

      注意：此方法与 uriBuilderFactory(UriBuilderFactory) 互斥。如果同时使用两者，此处提供的 defaultUriVariables 值将被忽略。

      See Also:
      • DefaultUriBuilderFactory.setDefaultUriVariables(Map)
      • uriBuilderFactory(UriBuilderFactory)

    • uriBuilderFactory

      WebClient.Builder uriBuilderFactory(UriBuilderFactory uriBuilderFactory)
      提供一个预配置的UriBuilderFactory实例。这是以下快捷属性的替代方案，并实际上覆盖了它们：
      • baseUrl(String)
      • defaultUriVariables(Map)。
      Parameters:
      uriBuilderFactory - 要使用的 URI 构建器工厂
      See Also:
      • baseUrl(String)
      • defaultUriVariables(Map)

    • apiVersionInserter

      WebClient.Builder apiVersionInserter(@Nullable ApiVersionInserter apiVersionInserter)
      Configure an ApiVersionInserter to abstract how an API version specified via WebClient.RequestHeadersSpec.apiVersion(Object) is inserted into the request.

      ApiVersionInserter 为几种内置的插入器实现类型提供了快捷方法。有关选项列表，请参阅 ApiVersionInserter 的类级别 Javadoc。

      Parameters:
      apiVersionInserter - 要使用的插入器
      Since:
      7.0

    • defaultStatusHandler

      WebClient.Builder defaultStatusHandler(Predicate<HttpStatusCode> statusPredicate, Function<ClientResponse, reactor.core.publisher.Mono<? extends Throwable>> exceptionFunction)
      Register a default status handler to apply to every response. Such default handlers are applied in the order in which they are registered, and after any others that are registered for a specific response.

      默认状态处理器不适用于 `exchangeTo*()` 方法，因为这些变体可以直接访问客户端响应。

      Parameters:
      statusPredicate - 用于匹配响应
      exceptionFunction - 将响应映射到错误信号
      Returns:
      此构建器
      Since:
      6.0

    • clientConnector

      WebClient.Builder clientConnector(ClientHttpConnector connector)
      Configure the ClientHttpConnector to use. This is useful for plugging in and/or customizing options of the underlying HTTP client library (for example, SSL).

      默认情况下，此值设置为 ReactorClientHttpConnector。

      Parameters:

    • exchangeStrategies

      WebClient.Builder exchangeStrategies(ExchangeStrategies strategies)
      Configure the ExchangeStrategies to use.

      对于大多数情况，建议使用codecs(Consumer)来自定义ExchangeStrategies中的编解码器，而不是替换它们。这样可以确保多个方都能为编解码器配置做出贡献。

      默认情况下，此值设置为ExchangeStrategies.withDefaults()。

      Parameters:
      strategies - 要使用的策略

    • exchangeFunction

      WebClient.Builder exchangeFunction(ExchangeFunction exchangeFunction)
      Provide an ExchangeFunction pre-configured with ClientHttpConnector and ExchangeStrategies.

      这是 `clientConnector(ClientHttpConnector)` 和 `exchangeStrategies(ExchangeStrategies)` 的替代方案，并实际上覆盖了它们。

      Parameters:
      exchangeFunction - 要使用的交换函数
